Recent performance indicators suggest a positive inflection point, as profit growth is currently outpacing one-year price growth by 68% [E58], supported by recent sales growth of 11% YoY [E66] and sequential quarterly sales increases [E68]. Furthermore, the stock is currently trading at only 26% of its 52-week range [E5] and is experiencing decelerating earnings growth [E71].
